annotations.text:
Tech-SaaS redesign — core flow.
Cool-grey neutrals, one teal accent, Geist throughout; the warm-editorial skin (paper + Instrument Serif + ochre/sage) is replaced. Layout structure and content are lifted from the live app. Foundations + Components define the system; Shell + the five core screens apply it. Remaining screens (Resume, Master résumé, Tailoring, Roadmap, LinkedIn, Settings, auth) follow the same system in a later pass.
